title: 'They're Perceived To Be Weak': Top Pollster Explains Why Democrats Should Not Shift to the Center
author: John Harwood
content:
Despite Democrats' failure to rally voters around a centrist agenda back in
2024, many in the party still believe that the "middle of the road" is key to
victory.

But in this Substack Live conversation, independent pollster G. Elliott Morris
tells John Harwood that those counseling Democrats to move toward the center
have got it wrong. There are no "**median voters " **there, as he describes to
Harwood - just people who pay little attention, have mixed views, and want
strong leaders.
